label: Nordic saga
blurb: A frost-bound northern realm of jarls, shield walls and dragon legends -- the mead-hall fantasy flavor of Skyrim-style RPGs.
context: Nordic saga fantasy character, frost-bound northern highlands, mead-hall and dragon-legend atmosphere

elf.label: Elf
elf.features: long pointed ears and pale, ageless features

beastfolk.label: Beastfolk
beastfolk.features: a pair of tufted lynx-like ears and a thick fur-lined tail

marshfolk.label: Marshfolk
marshfolk.features: smooth scaled skin, faintly webbed fingers and keen slitted eyes

orc.label: Orc
orc.features: a heavy brow, small tusks and battle-scarred skin

dwarf.label: Dwarf
dwarf.features: a broad frame built for mountain halls and a beard braided with small iron rings

hobbies: swimming in the fjord even in winter
racing longships at the summer gathering
telling ghost stories about the old barrows
quirks: touching the hammer charm at {poss} throat before a fight
never sailing on an unlucky day
sharpening {poss} blade every night whether it's dull or not
greeting every stranger with {poss} clan name first
keeping a raven feather for luck
never turning down a drinking challenge
reading omens in the flight of birds
always sitting with {poss} back to the wall
carving a notch for every year survived
spitting for luck before boarding a ship
goals: winning a seat of honor at the mead hall
being sung about in a saga someday
finding the lost blade of {poss} line
earning enough silver to winter comfortably
proving {poss} worth to a skeptical jarl
seeing the southern lands before {subj} dies
ending the feud between {poss} clan and the next hold over
surviving one more winter without losing anyone
becoming a name the young ones ask about
finding where the old gods still listen
keeping the hold's granary full through the dark season
peeves: boasting with nothing to back it up
a long winter with short rations
a bard who forgets the words
accessories: a hammer-shaped charm on a leather cord
a drinking horn at the belt
a small whetstone on a cord
a battered shield slung on the back
a bone comb tucked in a pouch
default_outfits: a fur-lined leather jerkin over a wool tunic, cross-gartered trousers and sturdy fur-trimmed boots

default_outfits.t: a long wool dress with a layered apron pinned at the shoulders with brooches, a fur-trimmed cloak and soft leather boots

default_outfits: a heavy wool cloak over a padded leather vest and tunic, thick trousers and fur-wrapped boots
_tables: The next five entries replace the shared tables in common.json for this setting only (same shape): braided sailor-warrior hair, heavy beards, almost no eyewear (a fantasy-medieval north), weathered/tattooed marks and no modern hair dye (the races already carry unusual natural colours).
